title: Reject fractional recursive JSON values when Double encoding would change their decimal value
description: Reject fractional recursive JSON values when Double encoding would change their decimal value
no_spec_change_rationale: This enforces the existing recursive JSON exact-value contract without changing the public API or canonical requirement.
acceptance_criteria: A fractional JSON value such as 1.0000000000000000001 fails decoding instead of becoming 1.0; supported finite numbers retain their decimal value after Double encoding; focused regressions and the full quality lane pass.
